note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), the original being in English; soldier not described in the original; synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records not translated.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head and thorax white to milky white; abdomen greyish white from intestinal contents showing through. Head and body moderately hairy. Head subcircular, with a minute white median spot (to mandibular base 0.70, width 0.87 mm). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 shortest, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2. Pronotum saddle-shaped (width 0.50–0.53 mm). Fore tibia slightly stout, tibial apical spurs 3:2:2 or 2:2:2; lateral spur of the fore tibia minute or absent.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule blackish brown, with a dark longitudinal stripe between the two ocelli; antennae and postclypeus pale yellowish brown; pronotum paler, yellowish brown in the middle and slightly darker at the sides; wings faintly brownish, transparent; abdominal dorsum brownish; sternites yellow, with a pale brown spot on each side. Head and body with a layer of short hairs and a few long hairs; abdominal pleural membrane densely hairy in males, sparsely so in females. Body length with wings 12.3–13.2, without wings 7.8–8.3 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (to mandibular base 0.77–0.83, greatest width including eyes 1.03–1.13 mm); area around the frontal plate depressed; frontal suture faint; in front of the frontal plate a minute pale spot, and above each ocellus a faint oval spot. Frontal plate small, depressed, semitransparent, round to oval (0.05–0.07 × 0.04–0.05 mm). Compound eyes suboval (maximum diameter 0.29–0.33 mm), equidistant from the ocelli, the antennae and the lateral margins (eye–ocellus distance 0.03–0.05, eye–antenna distance 0.03–0.07 mm). Ocelli oval (long diameter 0.13–0.15, short diameter 0.10–0.11 mm), semitransparent, at about half their short diameter from the compound eye. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus hairy, slightly convex, anterior margin slightly incurved; length less than half its width (length 0.17–0.20, width 0.49–0.51 mm). Anteclypeus hairless, semitransparent, middle slightly projecting forward. Labrum broadly ligulate, with a few short hairs (length 0.33–0.37, width 0.35–0.43 mm). Pronotum flat, slightly raised anteriorly, slightly narrower than the head (length 0.66–0.67, width 0.93–1.03 mm); anterior margin nearly straight or slightly convex, with a shallow median notch; posterior margin slightly incurved in the middle. Tibial apical spurs 3:2:2, tarsus 4-segmented. Wing membrane transparent, with papillae and numerous simple 2- or 3-pronged microstars (density 4000–4800/mm², size 4–5 × 2–2.5 μm); venation as in the genus. Fore wing 10.20–11.20, hind wing 9.80–10.2 mm.
